postCreateCommand: sudo chown -R vscode:vscode /home/vscode/.claude && source /usr/local/share/nvm/nvm.sh && claude install && echo 'export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"' >> /home/vscode/.bashrc; latest=$(ls -t /home/vscode/.claude/backups/.claude.json.backup.* 2>/dev/null | head -1) && [ -n "$latest" ] && cp "$latest" /home/vscode/.claude.json || true; bash .devcontainer/bootstrap-repos.sh --best-effort
postStartCommand: git config --global user.name "${GIT_USER_NAME}" && git config --global user.email "${GIT_USER_EMAIL}" && git config --global credential.helper 'store --file=/home/vscode/.claude/.git-credentials' && ~/.local/bin/claude update || true
